subject: Records redaction & archive plan for SOC 2 evidence
messages:
From: Sally Nguyen <sally.nguyen@acmehealth.com>
To: laura_bennett <laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: BrightPath Audit <audits@brightpathaudit.com>
Date: Mon, 30 Mar 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Records export request for upcoming SOC 2 (May)

Hi Laura,

Acme's auditors (BrightPath) will need admin activity and access logs for the review window Jan 1 2025 - Dec 31 2025. They asked for a deliverable that includes:
- admin activity ledger (user administrative actions, admin role changes, console logins)
- operator traces (job start/stop, deployments)
- a manifest with checksums and a short chain-of-custody statement

We understand you often provide redacted outputs — please confirm what fields you can redact, whether you can provide a full (non-sampled) export, and recommended transfer options (S3 pre-signed vs. PGP).

Do you have a sample package and an estimated timeline? Our audit kickoff is 2026-05-03 so we'd like final delivery by 2026-04-28.

Thanks,
Sally
Security Operations | Acme Health
From: laura_bennett <laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com>
To: Sally Nguyen <sally.nguyen@acmehealth.com>
Cc: ben_carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>, karthik_iyer <karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Mon, 30 Mar 2026 10:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Records export request for upcoming SOC 2 (May)

Hi Sally — thanks for the heads up and the date. We can definitely assemble an export that meets SOC 2 evidence needs; wanted to clarify scope and propose an approach before we lock timeline: 

1) Scope: you requested Jan 1 2025 - Dec 31 2025. We can provide a full fidelity export of admin activity and operator traces. For privacy-sensitive fields (user emails, IPs, tokens) we can provide either: (A) redacted values (e.g., "REDACTED_EMAIL"), (B) salted SHA256 hashes (deterministic within the package), or (C) partial redaction (username@domain -> username@****). Please confirm preference.

2) Sampling: given this is a SOC 2 evidence bundle, we recommend a full export (no sampling) for admin activity. If file size is a concern we can also supply a smaller representative sample plus a separate machine-readable manifest with counts per event type.

3) Transfer and encryption: recommended is an encrypted S3 bucket with customer KMS access + pre-signed URLs for retrieval. Alternatively we can provide a PGP-encrypted tarball over a signed DocuSign transfer acknowledgment.\n
4) Deliverables: sample package (small window, gzipped jsonl + manifest with SHA256 checksums), full export (jsonl.gz files), redaction report (CSV describing fields redacted and rationale), and a chain-of-custody manifest (signed SHA256 list).

Can you confirm: (a) redaction preference, (b) preferred transfer method, and (c) whether BrightPath needs logs in a specific schema? If you want, we can provide a 48-hour sample package by 2026-04-02.

Best,
Laura Bennett
Director, Security & Compliance | Redwood Inference
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>
To: laura_bennett <laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com>, karthik_iyer <karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com>, priyom_das <priyom.das@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, 31 Mar 2026 11:20:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Records export request for upcoming SOC 2 (May)

Laura / team — quick tech notes and estimates: 

- Export contents: admin_activity.jsonl.gz (~ compressed size 18GB for full 12mo window, estimated ~120M events), operator_traces.jsonl.gz (~4GB), access_index.csv (lightweight index for quick lookup).
- Redaction options implemented: deterministic salted SHA256 for user_id/email (salt stored in redaction_report encrypted with customer key), IP address partial mask (keep first two octets), tokens and keys removed entirely. We do not redact audit event ids or timestamps.
- File format: newline-delimited JSON (jsonl) compressed with gzip; manifest CSV: columns {filename, sha256, uncompressed_count, redaction_profile}.
- Checksums & chain-of-custody: we generate sha256 for each file and sign the manifest with an internal key. For customer verification we can PGP-sign the manifest or provide a signed JWT noting delivery timestamp.
- Transfer: prefer S3( kms-encrypted ) + pre-signed time-limited URLs. If Acme requires direct PGP envelope, we can PGP the tarball and upload to the same bucket.
- Timeline: sample package (48 hour window) ready by 2026-04-02 if Laura approves redaction profile. Full export (all 12 mo) can be produced by 2026-04-20 and staged for delivery by 2026-04-22.

Open Q: do we need to include system-level debug logs (these contain stacktraces with potential customer data) or only platform admin & operator traces?

—Ben
Ben Carter
Security Engineer, Redwood Inference
[attachment: export_sample_20260402.jsonl.gz (sample, ~12MB)]
From: laura_bennett <laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com>
To: Sally Nguyen <sally.nguyen@acmehealth.com>
Cc: BrightPath Audit <audits@brightpathaudit.com>, ben_carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>, karthik_iyer <karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com>, priyom_das <priyom.das@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Thu, 01 Apr 2026 14:38:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Records redaction & archive plan for SOC 2 evidence

Hi Sally / BrightPath — thanks for the clarifications over the last 48 hours. Below is the agreed plan and next steps: 

Agreed redaction profile: deterministic salted SHA256 for all user_email and user_id fields (salt held by Acme and provided via KMS-wrapped file during delivery), partial IP masking (x.x.*.*), remove any bearer tokens and API keys, preserve event ids and timestamps. Full export (no sampling) for Jan 1 2025 - Dec 31 2025.

Deliverables we will stage to Acme's S3 bucket (kms key: arn:aws:kms:us-west-2:123456:key/EXAMPLE):
- admin_activity_20250101_20251231.jsonl.gz (sha256: 3a7f...e9c)
- operator_traces_20250101_20251231.jsonl.gz (sha256: b4d2...7f1)
- export_manifest_20260401.csv (includes file checksums, uncompressed counts, redaction_profile)
- redaction_guidelines_v2.pdf (human-readable rules and mapping)
- chain_of_custody.txt (signed manifest with timestamp and exporter id)

Security & verification: files encrypted at rest (AES-256) and in-transfer via HTTPS to pre-signed URLs. Manifest will be PGP-signed by Redwood and we will share the public verification key. We will also provide SHA256 checksums in the manifest for your auditor to validate integrity post-download.

Timeline:
- Sample package (48-hr window) uploaded to Drive for review by 2026-04-02 (link below).
- Full export produced by 2026-04-20 and staged to your S3 by 2026-04-22.
- Delivery acknowledgement (signed DocuSign) requested by 2026-04-25 so your team has time to ingest before audit kickoff.

Next steps for Acme:
1) Confirm redaction profile above (salted hashes + partial IP mask).
2) Provide destination S3 bucket ARN and KMS key or confirm preference for PGP envelope.
3) Confirm whether BrightPath requires native timestamps in UTC or if local timestamps are acceptable (we default to UTC).

Links & sample package: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/0B_example/sample-package 
HubSpot: HS-12345

If you confirm today we will kick the export job and provide the sample by Friday.

Best regards,
Laura Bennett
Director, Security & Compliance | Redwood Inference
